blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. has issued several proclamations declaring special non-working days in nine localities in October to allow residents to participate in local celebrations and historical commemorations. Proclamation No. 1466 declared Oct. 12 a special non-working day in Talisay, Batangas, in commemoration of the Battle of Batangas. READ: Marcos heading to Singapore for working visit Oct. 7 – 11 Proclamation No. 1468 declared Oct. 9 a special non-working day in San Isidro, Surigao del Norte, for its 67th founding anniversary.
